terms.gloss: a street with traffic in one direction
terms.comment: “A street of one course”, the same phrase Traupman uses for a one-way ticket (tessera ūnīus cursūs).

phrases.latin: Hāc vehiculīs īre nōn licet; via est ūnīus cursūs.
phrases.english: Cars can’t go this way; it’s a one-way street.

sources: Lewis & Short: cursus · Lewis & Short: unus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 354.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. street.
